We are looking for a Business Analyst, BI & Analytics, Global Operational Excellence, Air & Sea who will be resposible for supports the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of Business Intelligence across Air & Sea. The role ensures structured, reliable, and user-friendly reporting to support operational performance management and decision-making.
Working within Global Operational Excellence and under the guidance of the Manager, BI & Analytics, the BI Analyst translates business requirements into scalable reporting solutions and contributes to standardization and automation across regions.
 Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain reporting solutions 
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports 
Translate business requirements into structured data models and visualizations 
Ensure reports are intuitive, actionable, and aligned with business needs 
Support migration of legacy reports into standardized BI solutions 
 Ensure data quality and consistency 
Validate data accuracy and investigate inconsistencies 
Apply and follow KPI definitions, governance standards, and data structures 
Support root cause analysis of data issues in collaboration with stakeholders 
Contribute to improving data reliability and transparency 
 Drive standardization and automation 
Contribute to consolidating reporting into standardized solutions 
Identify opportunities to reduce manual reporting and increase automation 
Support development and monitoring of data pipelines 
Follow best practices in BI development and documentation 
 Support business decision-making 
Provide insights and analysis to support performance management 
Identify trends, deviations, and improvement opportunities 
Support ad-hoc analysis requests in a structured and scalable way 
Help stakeholders interpret reporting and use data effectively 
 Collaborate across teams 
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs 
Collaborate with CIA and technical teams to ensure aligned delivery 
Support rollout, testing, and adoption of BI solutions 
Participate in BI workgroups and contribute structured input 
 Qualifications:
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail 
Ability to structure data and translate requirements into solutions 
Understanding of operational KPIs and performance reporting 
Experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization) 
Proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office 
Basic understanding of SQL and data structures 
Familiarity with Power Platform (e.g., Power Automate) is a plus 
Proven ability to define and enforce standards 
Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability 
Ability to balance execution and governance 
Clear and structured communication 
Ability to work with stakeholders across functions and regions 
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) 
Structured, organized, and quality-oriented 
Focus on simplicity and usability 
Proactive and solution-driven 
Willingness to learn and continuously improve
 DSV – Global transport and logistics
 Working at DSV means playing in a different league.
As a global leader in transport and logistics, we have been on an extraordinary journey of growth. Let’s grow together as we continue to innovate, digitalise and build on our achievements.
With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we work every day to offer solid services and meet our customers’ needs and help them achieve their goals. We know that the best way to achieve this is by bringing in new talent, fresh perspectives and ambitious individuals like you.
At DSV, performance is in our DNA. We don’t just work – we aim to shape the future of logistics. This ambition fuels a dynamic environment built on collaboration with world-class team players, accountability and action. We value inclusivity, embrace different cultures and respect the dignity and rights of every individual. If you want to make an impact, be trusted by customers and grow your career in a forward-thinking company – this is the place to be.
